description: 紫微星系安星表：以五行局數與農曆生日推紫微位置，其餘紫微系星曜以紫微為基準逆行。

ziweiPosition.note: ziweiBranchIndex = f(bureauNumber, lunarDay). Algorithm: find smallest x such that (day + x) % bureau == 0; q = (day + x) / bureau; if x is even, branchIndex = q + x - 1 (0=zi); if x is odd, branchIndex = q - x - 1. Normalized to 0..11.

tianfuPosition.note: 天府與紫微以寅申線對稱：tianfuIndex = 4 - ziweiIndex (mod 12), i.e. mirrored across yin-shen axis.
